normalattack.name: Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield
normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, he will consume all <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> to instead perform the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.{LINK#N11370002}{/LINK}

elementalskill.name: Active Defense: Bastion Charge
elementalskill.description: Valeriy raises his shield cannon and charges forward, dealing AoE Electro DMG, gaining 40 Impact Momentum, and deploying a Supercharged Shield. The Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against Electro DMG. "Victory takes time, sound judgment, and decisive action when the moment is right."

elementalburst.name: Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo
elementalburst.description: Deals AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents and fires a Thunderburst Shell high into the air. The Thunderburst Shell disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents. \n\n"Steel your resolve, take the field in heavy armor, and bring death thundering down upon the enemy."

p1.name: Advance With the Creeping Barrage
p1.description: Valeriy gains 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> whenever a nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an attack whose Elemental Type is <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> while the <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are falling. He can gain up to 80 <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.

p2.name: Into the Breach
p2.description: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370002}Offensive Directive{/LINK}</color> is enhanced based on the amount of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed when performing his special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. Each point consumed further increases the DMG granted by <color=#FFD780FF>Offensive Directive</color>. If Valeriy is:\n·In the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state: Each point of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> consumed increases this DMG by an amount equal to 0.9% of Valeriy's ATK;\n·Not in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state: Each point of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> consumed increases this DMG by an amount equal to 0.3% of Valeriy's ATK.

p3.name: Tundra Operational Intelligence
p3.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.

const1.name: The Cadence of Suppressive Fire
const1.description: Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. For every 10 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs <color=#FFD780FF>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</color>, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.\nAdditionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>, he gains an additional amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.

const2.name: Ranks That Charge as One
const2.description: All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>.\nAdditionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, any further <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> can be converted in this way.

const3.name: Vigilance at Close Quarters
const3.description: Increases the Level of Normal Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30601}Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const4.name: Fortitude Unshaken by Attrition
const4.description: Maximum <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> is increased by 30, and the amount gained is increased by 30%.

const5.name: Resolve to Divide and Destroy
const5.description: Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

const6.name: The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines
const6.description: The special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are enhanced: Their DMG is increased by 100%, and opponents they hit have the CRIT Rate of <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> they take increased by 10% for 7s. If the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> taken is Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, its CRIT DMG is also increased by 40%.

hyperlinks.name: Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment
hyperlinks.description: Valeriy's special Charged Attack. Using a Charged Attack while he has at least 40 Impact Momentum consumes all Impact Momentum to unleash this special Charged Attack instead, dealing AoE Electro DMG in front of him and granting 15 stacks of Offensive Directive.

hyperlinks.name: Offensive Directive
hyperlinks.description:
A special effect Valeriy gains after performing the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment. It increases different types of Electro DMG depending on whether Valeriy is in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state. If Valeriy is:
·In the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state: When a nearby active character in the party deals Electro DMG considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG to an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of Offensive Directive is consumed to increase that DMG, with the increase based on Valeriy's ATK;
·Not in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state: When a nearby active character in the party deals Electro DMG to an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of Offensive Directive is consumed to increase that DMG, with the increase based on Valeriy's ATK.
When a single instance of Electro DMG hits multiple opponents simultaneously, Offensive Directive stacks are consumed based on the number of opponents hit.

hyperlinks.name: Impact Momentum
hyperlinks.description:
A special energy Valeriy uses to enhance his combat capabilities. Its initial maximum is 100. When he has at least 40 Impact Momentum, he can perform the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment.
Valeriy can gain Impact Momentum in the following ways:
·By using his Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge;
·After unlocking the Passive Talent "Advance With the Creeping Barrage," while his Elemental Burst Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo is active, when a nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an attack whose Elemental Type is Electro.
